causal_conclusion: The separate diagnostic yaw-input policy (earlier original ACA release, bounded right-only trim pulses and added neutral dwells) obtains both relative-yaw targets and original range/velocity data-good with nonsentinel dH at first N68 in both profiles. The previous exact-input policy reproduces its original overshoot and invalid-radar result. The policy intervention is sufficient to change the observed outcome with unchanged models/data; release timing alone is not isolated. Non-yaw input semantics are preserved but some timestamps differ. This does not certify full pilot attitude, historical flight parity or an operational V57 decision.
